INFINITY ARCADE - GAME DEVELOPER TECHNICAL GUIDE
FILE FORMAT
ZIP archive · max 10 MB total
Individual files · max 2 MB each
index.html must be at the root of the zip (not inside a subfolder)
OS junk files (.DS_Store, __MACOSX, Thumbs.db) are stripped automatically
TECH STACK
Any browser-native technology - HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Canvas, WebGL, WebAudio
All assets must be bundled in the zip - no runtime CDN fetches
No server-side code - Node.js, PHP, Python backends will not work
No top-level navigation - do not use top.location redirects
No native dialogs - alert(), confirm(), prompt() are blocked in iframes
Avoid localStorage keys that could clash - prefix yours with your game name
IFRAME ENVIRONMENT
Your game runs in a sandboxed iframe - keyboard focus is passed to it automatically on load
The arcade communicates with your game via the postMessage API
POSTMESSAGE API
Hand off your latest final score:
window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'LATEST_SCORE', score: 1234 }, '*');
Alias supported during beta:
window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'ARCADE_SET_LATEST_SCORE', score: 1234 }, '*');
Save a checkpoint:
window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'SAVE_CHECKPOINT', gameId: 'your-game-id', data: { level: 3, hp: 80 } }, '*');
Max 50 KB per save · stored on-chain per player per game
Load a checkpoint:
window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'LOAD_CHECKPOINT', gameId: 'your-game-id' }, '*'); // Listen for response: window.addEventListener('message', (e) => { if (e.data.type === 'arcade-checkpoint-data') { /* e.data.data, e.data.savedAt */ } });
Query player NFT inventory:
window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'GET_INVENTORY' }, '*'); // Listen for response: window.addEventListener('message', (e) => { if (e.data.type === 'arcade-inventory') { // e.data.nfts = [{ canisterId, tokenId, name, imageUrl, collection }] // e.data.total = total NFT count } });
Filter inventory by collection:
window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'GET_INVENTORY', collection: 'degen-fighter' }, '*');
PLAYER STATS & PROGRESSION
Query player level and experience:
window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'GET_PLAYER_STATS' }, '*'); // Listen for response: window.addEventListener('message', (e) => { if (e.data.type === 'arcade-player-stats') { // e.data.gxpLevel (1-10), e.data.dvpLevel (1-10) // e.data.gxp (raw XP), e.data.dvp (raw points) // e.data.gxpPercentile (0-100), e.data.dvpPercentile (0-100) } });
Query player badges:
window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'GET_BADGES' }, '*'); // Listen for response: window.addEventListener('message', (e) => { if (e.data.type === 'arcade-badges') { // e.data.badges = ['standard', 'hsh', 'dev-contributor', ...] } });
What you can do with this:
Unlock content based on GXP level - higher-level players get stronger weapons, secret levels, bonus characters, cosmetic skins
Gate features by DVP level - reward DAO participants with exclusive in-game perks
Check badge types - give dev-contributor badge holders dev tools, give HSH holders unique items
Combine with NFT inventory - own a Degen Fighter NFT + GXP level 5 = unlock the ultimate weapon
GXP = Gamer Experience (earned by playing games) · DVP = DAO Veteran Points (earned by voting and creating proposals)
Levels range from 1-10 · Percentiles show where the player ranks among all players (0-100)
CONTROLLER & INPUT
12-button standard - keyboard and gamepad both supported
Players configure controls once in the arcade Input Config hub - mappings forwarded to your game automatically via postMessage
Button labels: A B X Y · L1 R1 L2 R2 · Start Select · L3 R3
Local multiplayer: up to 4 players · keyboard splits automatically · each player gets their own mapped controls
SCORING & TICKET PAYOUTS
Ticket payouts use each game's admin-calibrated 8-level score ladder from the live backend source of truth.
Level 1 -> 0 Tickets
Level 2 -> 1 Ticket
Level 3 -> 2 Tickets
Level 4 -> 3 Tickets
Level 5 -> 4 Tickets
Level 6 -> 5 Tickets
Level 7 -> 6 Tickets
Ticket payouts are capped by the backed ticket pool and may pay 0 if the pool is empty or the game's ladder is not enabled.
Caps: 20 plays/hour, 30s cooldown, 2,000 tickets/day, 7 tickets/round. No first-5-play no-ticket gate in Phase 1 payout configs.
REVENUE SHARE (SHOWROOM ONLY)
Ticket games: 10% of tokens inserted goes to you · 80% into the ticket pool · 5% arcade · 5% DAO
Non-ticket games: 80% of tokens inserted goes to you · 10% DAO gaming rewards · 10% burned
The Back games: no revenue share
Creator/seller earnings accrue as ICP-denominated claimable earnings tracked separately from player arcade credits; claiming is manual when you choose to request payout.
Gameplay revenue share only applies while your game holds Showroom or DAO Favourites tier
SUBMISSION FEES
The Back: 10 ICP · reviewed by admin · hosted on-chain after approval
Showroom application: 25 ICP · reviewed by admin · hosted on-chain after approval
Submission fees are non-refundable, including on rejection or removal
RATE LIMITS (TRANSPARENT TO HONEST PLAYERS)
30 second cooldown between plays per player
20 plays per hour per player
Configured payout ladder controls ticket activation; no first-5-play no-ticket gate for configured games
These limits protect the ticket economy and do not affect legitimate players
SCORE FORMAT
Score must be a positive integer - no floats, no strings, no negatives
Higher is always better - score thresholds award tickets from the backed ticket pool
Float scores should be multiplied and floored before sending (e.g. 12.34 → 1234)
YOUR GAME ID
After submission, your game is assigned a unique ID (e.g. game-1-1773541188866276491)
You need this ID for the checkpoint postMessage API
Find it in your Developer Dashboard under Your Games
ASSET LOADING
Your game must be fully self-contained - all images, audio, fonts, and scripts inside the zip
Runtime fetch() or XMLHttpRequest to external URLs will fail due to iframe sandboxing or CORS
AUDIO & MUSIC
Audio is fully supported - WebAudio API, HTML5 Audio, OGG, MP3, WAV
All audio files must be bundled in your zip - remember the 10 MB total / 2 MB per file limits
Recommended approaches (small footprint):
Short loops - a 30-second track at 64kbps mono OGG is ~250 KB. Three loops (menu, gameplay, game over) fits under 1 MB
Chiptune / tracker music - 8-bit and 16-bit style music is tiny (50-200 KB for a full soundtrack). Tools: Bosca Ceoil, BeepBox, FamiTracker, OpenMPT
Procedural audio - generate music and SFX in code with WebAudio API or libraries like Tone.js, SoundBox, jsfxr. Zero file size
MIDI playback - MIDI files are 5-50 KB per song. Render with a JS soundfont library (e.g. MIDI.js, tonejs-instruments)
Avoid uncompressed WAV for music - a 1-minute WAV is ~10 MB and will blow your entire budget
OGG Vorbis is preferred over MP3 for smaller size at equal quality. Most browsers support both
SFX tip: use jsfxr or sfxr.me to generate retro sound effects procedurally - zero file size, fits the arcade aesthetic
TICKET POOL (SHOWROOM TICKET GAMES)
Ticket games start with a seeded ticket pool - 20% of your Showroom submission fee converts to tickets when your game goes live
The pool grows as players insert Tokens and shrinks as Tickets are awarded for scores
Ticket payouts are capped by the backed ticket pool and may pay 0 if the pool is empty.
If your game is removed, the remaining backed ticket pool stays reserved for that game economy; it is not redirected to DAO rewards.
GAME REMOVAL
You can request removal at any time from your Developer Dashboard
Submission fees are non-refundable on removal
Removal requests are processed by admin - your game stays live until confirmed
Outstanding creator earnings remain claimable after removal
SCREENSHOTS
Up to 5 screenshots per game displayed on your game detail page
Provide image URLs to admin - set via the admin panel on your behalf
Recommended: 16:9 ratio · min 800px wide

HELP CENTER
GETTING STARTED
Infinity Arcade is a decentralized gaming hub built on the Internet Computer Protocol (ICP). Play games, earn tickets, collect NFTs, and participate in community governance - all 100% on-chain. No accounts, no passwords. Just connect with Internet Identity and play.
Click "Connect / Create" in the top bar. This opens Internet Identity - a decentralized authentication system by DFINITY. You can create a new identity using your device's biometrics (fingerprint, Face ID) or a security key. No email, no password. Your identity is cryptographically yours.
You need Tokens. Deposit ICP into your arcade account (1 ICP = 100 Tokens), then spend Tokens to play. Every Showroom game costs 1 Token: ticket games charge per run, other games per visit (sessions last up to 2 hours). Games in The Back are free. In ticket games, your score decides how many Tickets you win from that game's prize pool.
No. You earn Tickets based on your skill and score - not random chance. There are no slot machines, no dice rolls, no house edge. Play well, earn more. Simple as that.
TOKENS & TICKETS
Tokens are your play credits: 1 ICP = 100 Tokens, and every Showroom game costs 1 Token per run or visit. Tokens are stored on-chain in your arcade account. You can gift them to another player (see below), but they can't be traded, listed on exchanges or turned back into ICP. Think of them like arcade quarters.
Tickets are prize/perk points. When you play a game and score well, you earn Tickets from that game's prize pool. Tickets can be redeemed for NFTs, badges, perks, and Prize Booth items. Tickets cannot be exchanged for ICP, cash, or fiat.
It depends on the game type. Ticket games send 80% into that game's Ticket pool, 10% to the game's creator, 5% to the arcade and 5% to the DAO treasury. Non-ticket games send 50% to the game's creator, 30% to the arcade and 20% to the DAO treasury.
You can send Tokens: open your Wallet, use Send Tokens and enter the other player's Principal ID. Sending is free, with a limit of 1,000 Tokens per 24 hours, and the other player needs a profile name. Tickets can't be sent: they stay with the player who earned them.
ICP you have deposited but not yet turned into Tokens can be withdrawn from your Wallet at any time. Tokens and Tickets stay inside the arcade: Tokens are for play, and Tickets are for Prize Booth redemptions. NFTs you redeem can be withdrawn to an external wallet. Creator earnings are separate and paid in ICP (see How much do I earn?).
GAMES
Games run in your browser inside the arcade. In ticket games, each 1-Token payment buys one run: when the run ends, press Submit Score and your score sets your Ticket payout from that game's prize pool (up to 7 Tickets per run, more with a jackpot). Game sessions last up to 2 hours. Higher scores = more Tickets. Each game has its own prize pool, funded by the Tokens players spend on it.
Some ticket games have score jackpots: extra Tickets for reaching a high score or setting a new record, paid from that game's prize pool. Jackpots are paid only to DAO members, meaning anyone with at least 1 Voting Power (a Voting Power Badge from the Prize Booth, or a Dev/Artist Contributor badge). Everyone else still earns the normal Tickets for their score, and the arcade tells you when a score would have won a jackpot.
Yes - games that support checkpoints will save your progress to your account. Come back tomorrow and pick up where you left off. Your save data is tied to your identity, so it works on any device you log into.
Yes, in games that support it. Two players can share the keyboard (usually Player 1 on W A S D and Player 2 on the arrow keys), and more players can join with USB or Bluetooth controllers. Use the Connect Controllers button at the bottom of the Showroom, The Back or Blackhole to choose which player each controller is.
Yes. Open the arcade on your phone or tablet and the Play section lists every Showroom and The Back game its creator made for phones. Desktop-only games are hidden there, so you never spend a Token on a game you can't control. Your wallet and NFTs work on mobile too; forums, the DAO and the Prize Booth are on desktop.
Yes. Pair any USB or Bluetooth controller (Xbox, PlayStation, Switch Pro and most others), then press a button on it with the arcade open. The Connect Controllers button at the bottom of the Showroom, The Back and Blackhole shows the connection status, lets you choose which player each controller is, and has fixes for common problems. Each game decides what the buttons do, and many let you reassign them from a Controls option on their title screen. Keyboard keys can be changed from the gear icon on your Profile.
The Back is the proving ground: any developer can submit a game there, every game is free to play, players rate games with likes and dislikes, and players can tip creators. The Showroom is the main stage: vetted games that cost 1 Token per run or visit, including ticket games with prize pools. Creators earn from Showroom plays and purchases, and from tips in The Back.
NFTs & PRIZES
The Prize Booth has NFTs you can redeem with Tickets. These are real NFTs minted on-chain - once redeemed, they're in your arcade wallet. You can use them as profile pictures, hold them as collectibles, or withdraw them to an external wallet.
Yes, in games that support them. Official Arcade NFTs carry perk tags that games can read to unlock extras such as skins, titles, special weapons or bonus content. In ticket games, perks are cosmetic only and never affect your score. Only NFTs you hold count, not ones listed in the Prize Booth.
Voting Power Badges grant voting power in the DAO: 1 VP per badge, bought in sequence from the Prize Booth with Tickets (up to 10). Dev and Artist Contributor badges add 1 VP each. More badges unlock more: proposals at 2, lottery entries at 3, 4, 6, 8 and 9, and DAO forum tiers at 5, 7 and 10.
DAO & GOVERNANCE
The DAO is the community governance system. Voting Power Badge holders can vote on proposals that shape the arcade - which games get promoted, what features get built, how the treasury is managed. It's a glorified polling machine: proposals that pass go to the dev team for implementation.
You need at least 1 Voting Power: a Voting Power Badge from the Prize Booth, or a Dev/Artist Contributor badge. Enter through the DAO door on the landing page. Voting Power Badges unlock more as you collect them: 2 badges = create proposals, 3 = Token Lottery #1, 4 = Ticket Lottery #1, 5 = DAO forum tier 1 (Voting and Treasury Talk), 6 = Token Lottery #2, 7 = tier 2 (Elite’s Corner), 8 = Ticket Lottery #2, 9 = Token Lottery #3, 10 = tier 3 (Diplomat’s Only). Every lottery entry wins exactly once per 8-week cycle. Any Voting Power also makes you eligible to win game jackpots.
No. The DAO is advisory. All passed proposals are reviewed by the development team before implementation. The arcade reserves the right to reject proposals that would harm the platform, its economy, or its users. Think of it as a strong suggestion box, not a boardroom.
FOR GAME DEVELOPERS
Click "Submit a Game" in the Showroom or The Back, then upload your game as a .zip (with an index.html) and a thumbnail. The submission fee is 10 ICP for The Back or 25 ICP for the Showroom, paid from your arcade deposit and non-refundable, and every game is reviewed before it goes live. Your game talks to the arcade through simple postMessage calls for scores, saves and controller input. The creator guides cover every requirement.
Showroom games build up creator earnings as claimable ICP: 10% of each Token spent on a ticket game, and 50% on a non-ticket game (including purchases). Tips add to them. Claim manually at any time on the Creator Earnings page, or turn on Auto-payout to have them sent every 14 days to an address you choose (a new address takes 48 hours to take effect). Claimed ICP arrives minus the 0.0001 ICP ledger fee. Submission fees and all other payments are non-refundable.
No. Zero. Your game is a normal HTML5/JavaScript game. It talks to the arcade through simple browser postMessage calls - the same API websites already use. No wallet integration, no canister calls, no Motoko. You make the game, we make it Web3.
The arcade provides checkpoint saves (your game sends save data, arcade stores it per-player) and local multiplayer input (up to 4 players via keyboard split + controllers). All through postMessage. Add 5-10 lines of code and your game supports saves and local co-op.
Infinity Arcade enforces a strict IP Strike System. Strike 1: Content removed, formal warning, submission fees non-refundable. Strike 2: Content removed, soft ban (minimum 30 days), all submissions reviewed, Voting Power Badges may be revoked. Strike 3: Content removed, permanent hard ban, all badges revoked, soulbound assets forfeited. Strikes never expire. Egregious infringement (ripping published games, uploading well-known copyrighted characters) may skip directly to Strike 2 or 3. Full details are in our Terms of Service.
Still have questions? Visit the Community Forum or ask in the DAO Discussion
